guide.landing: Welcome to SatsPoint, the till that takes bitcoin and mobile money. To start, tap the big yellow button “Create my shop”; if you already have an account, tap the white button right next to it.
guide.langue: Tap the big box of your language. The small speaker in the corner of each box says the name of the language.
guide.accueil: To open your shop, tap the big yellow button. If you already have an account, tap the white button just below.
guide.inscription: Here you create your account with your name, your phone number and a password. If you can't write, ask a relative or a SatsPoint agent to fill in these boxes with you: after that, everything works with pictures and voice.
guide.connexion: Type your phone number and your password, then tap the big yellow button “Sign in”. Someone you trust can type them with you.
guide.motDePasseOublie: Type the phone number or email address of your account, then tap the yellow button: you will receive a way to choose a new password.
guide.reinitialisation: Choose a new password, then tap the yellow button to save it.
guide.verification2fa: Open your code app and type the six-digit code it shows. If you lost your phone, type one of your backup codes.
guide.deuxFacteurs: To protect this account, scan the black square with a code app, then type the six-digit code it shows. Keep the backup codes in a safe place.

demarrage.boutique: First step: your shop's name, your phone and your city. If you can't write, ask a relative or a SatsPoint agent to fill in the boxes with you, then tap the yellow button “Create my shop”; the rest works with pictures and voice.
demarrage.portefeuille: Second step: link your bitcoin wallet. Paste its connection link or scan it with the camera; a relative or a SatsPoint agent can do it with you.
demarrage.mobileMoney: Third step, optional: mobile money, to receive Wave, Orange Money or Free Money. You can do it later by tapping “Skip”.
demarrage.test: Last step: a test payment of one hundred francs. Tap the yellow button and pay yourself; when the screen turns green, your till is ready.
demarrage.termine: Your till is ready. Tap the yellow button to go to the till and make your first sale.

guide.caisse: Type the price on the big keys, then tap the big yellow “Charge” button at the bottom. The key with the arrow erases the last digit.
guide.choixMoyen: Choose how the customer pays: tap the bitcoin box with the lightning bolt, or a mobile money box such as Wave or Orange Money.

paiement.bitcoin: Show this black square to the customer: they scan it with their bitcoin wallet. When the screen turns green, the money has arrived.
paiement.mobileMoney: The customer scans this black square with their phone and pays with mobile money. Wait: the screen turns green as soon as the money arrives.
paiement.moyenPays: The customer pays you with this number or this black square. When the money is in your account, tap the yellow button “Confirm receipt”.
paiement.waveDirect: The customer scans this black square with Wave and pays you. When the money is in your Wave account, the owner or the manager taps the yellow button “Confirm receipt”.

guide.succes: Payment received, the sale is saved. Tap the white button to send the receipt to the customer, or the big yellow button for a new sale.
guide.ventes: Here are your sales, the latest at the top. A green badge means paid, a gold badge means pending; tap a sale to see its details.
guide.venteDetail: Here are the details of the sale: the amount, the payment method and the time. The buttons at the bottom send the receipt or resume the payment.
guide.tableau: Your dashboard: at the top, the money collected and the number of sales; the curve shows your sales day after day. The round buttons at the top change the period.
guide.portefeuille: Your bitcoin wallet: the big number is your balance. Tap the yellow button to receive, the white button to send; the history is below.
guide.articles: Your items, with their picture and price. Tap an item's speaker to hear its name. To create one, tap the yellow “Add” button: a photo or a picture, its name said out loud, then its price on the big keys.
guide.equipe: Your team: each person with their role. Tap the yellow button to invite a cashier or a manager with a link to send them.
guide.reglages: Your shop settings: its name, the payment methods and your preferences. After a change, tap the yellow “Save” button of the part you changed.
guide.recu: Here is the receipt of the purchase: the amount paid, the shop and the time. You can keep it on your phone or print it.
guide.invitation: A shop is inviting you to its team. Tap the yellow button to accept; if you don't have an account yet, you will create one first.
guide.console: The platform console: shops, service health, the log, languages and payment methods. Tap a tab at the top to change section.
guide.studio: The audio studio: each row is a sentence of the app, each column a language. Tap a box, press the red microphone, speak after three, two, one, then confirm: silences are cut automatically.
guide.aideProche: Ask a relative or a SatsPoint agent to fill in these boxes with you. After that, everything works with pictures and voice.

feuille.sousTitre: Listen to the app in your language.
feuille.activerAide: Speakers and the help of each screen.
feuille.aucuneAide: This page has no voice help.
